attribution.note: Marcus's own bullet in his own post, listing recent developments he endorses.

semantics.note: An observation about the post's 'last two weeks'. The normalised text leaves out that window, but the contract restores it. 'Starts seeing' plainly means a new relationship, not the first one ever.

contract.note: The plain reading of the metaphor is a new commercial AI tie-up beyond OpenAI between Feb 15 and Feb 29, 2024. That reading is ordinary, and it is fair. It does not demand a first-ever partnership or a break with OpenAI.

evidence.note: Mistral's dated Feb 26, 2024 announcement of a partnership with Microsoft to offer its models on Azure. It is a company disclosure, but the contract asks for exactly this kind of partner announcement.
Microsoft's Inworld partnership from Nov 2023 falls before the window. It rules out a first-ever reading but does not affect whether the February development happened.

reviews.rationale: On Feb 26, 2024, inside the target window, Mistral announced a new partnership with Microsoft to distribute its models on Azure. That is a new Microsoft commercial arrangement with an AI startup other than OpenAI, which meets the support condition. The earlier Inworld deal only shows this was not Microsoft's first such deal, and the claim did not say it was.
